Hello! I am currently a PhD student in Linguistics at the University of Alberta. I received my BSc with Honours in Psychology in 2022 and my MA in Linguistics in 2026 at the University of Saskatchewan.

My current research interests include: cognitive linguistics/psycholinguistics and (mis)information processing; particularly the relationship between personality and openmindedness with veracity judgments concerning misinformation seen online.

I am a linguist, a writing tutor, and aspiring academic.
